# Philosophy of Christ

*Concept associated with [Erasmus](../philosophers/erasmus.md)*

[Erasmus](../philosophers/erasmus.md)'s phrase for a simple, inward piety grounded in the Gospel reread in its sources rather than in the theology of the schools or in outward practices.

**At stake in** : [Faith and reason](../axes/faith-reason.md)

**See also** : [Studia humanitatis](../glossary/studia-humanitatis.md)
